description: Massachusetts Historic Power Outages is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The electric companies file their emergency response plan (ERP) reports, which list information about historic power outages. It includes information such as city or town where the outage occurred, number of customers affected, outage duration, time the outage occurred, and reason for outage. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are historic outage data , electricity outages, electric power failures. The portal shows 2024-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
